newsitem.title: USA: Odyssey Partners creates aerospace hardware firm.
newsitem.headline: Odyssey Partners creates aerospace hardware firm.

text.p: Odyssey Partners said Wednesday it had acquired Aviall Inc.'s aerospace division and a controlling interest in Tri-Star Aerospace to create an aerospace hardware distribution company with annual revenues in excess of $100 million.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
A spokeswoman for Odyssey, an investment partnership, said Tri-Star's owner retains a minority position in the company.
Aviall announced the sale of its aerospace division Friday.
